answer_2.quote: We follow (Elgohary et al., 2020) and use the correction accuracy as our main evaluation measure: each example in SPLASH test set contains an initial parse P ˜and a gold parse P ˆ. With a predicted (corrected) parse by a correction model P ¯, they compute the correction accuracy using the exact-set-match between P ¯and P ˆaveraged over all test examples.
